gaps.sentence: No sooner had he sat down ___ the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: No sooner … than — fixed pair with inversion after 'no sooner'.

gaps.sentence: Try ___ she might, she couldn't restart the engine.
gaps.explanation: 'Try as somebody might' — fixed concessive inversion.

gaps.sentence: ___ the storm passed did the ferries resume service.
gaps.explanation: Only after/once the storm passed did… — fronted 'only' phrase.

gaps.sentence: Never have I ___ such a stubborn refusal.
gaps.explanation: Inversion: Never have I + past participle — never adds emphasis.

gaps.sentence: To such an extent ___ prices risen that buyers withdrew.
gaps.hint: To such an extent + past perfect
gaps.explanation: To such an extent had prices risen that… — emphatic result.

gaps.sentence: Only since the redesign ___ the app gained new users.
gaps.explanation: 'Only since the redesign has the app gained …' — perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Little ___ the chances of success be improved by patience.
gaps.explanation: Little will the chances be improved… — inversion with future.

gaps.sentence: Reluctant ___ she was to intervene, the referee stopped the match.
gaps.explanation: Fronted adjective + though/as + subject is emphatic concession: Reluctant though she was…
